mechanism: Rizatriptan is a 5-HT1B/1D agonist that can cause vasoconstriction, which may be problematic in patients on sacubitril (ARNI) due to potential blood pressure effects and additive cardiovascular stress.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; use rizatriptan cautiously in patients on sacubitril, particularly those with coronary artery disease or uncontrolled hypertension; consider alternative analgesics if possible.
